title: Why threads button of top menu still display 1 ?

messages.text: Why threads button of top menu still display 1 ? i try to find my unseen thread, there have no one unseen.

The 1 is T-081, a closed thread you haven't opened.
- T-081 was an automatic phone-idle alarm from 06:48 UTC. It closed itself at 07:10 UTC while 2 messages in it were still unread.
- The badge counts unread messages in closed threads too, but the Threads page lists closed threads at the bottom, so it is easy to miss.
- Open T-081 once (scroll down to the closed threads) and the 1 goes away. Nothing in it needs you now: the phone test it was about is done.
- I've asked the lead to have the badge skip closed threads, or show where the unread one is.
What you need to do: nothing, or open T-081 to clear the badge.

It's a bug: the 1 is a closed thread, T-081, that still has 2 replies you haven't opened.
- T-081 was an automatic 'phone unused' alarm from 06:48Z. It was closed at 07:10Z, so it sits at the bottom of the list, among the closed threads.
- The counter still counts unread replies in closed threads. That is wrong: it should only count threads you can act on.
- Fix: the agent building the thread merge tool (ts-threads) adds 'closed threads don't count' to its change. I'll tell you here when it is live.
What you need to do: nothing. If you want the 1 gone now, open T-081 at the bottom of the Threads list.
Update, it stuck on 2 already. i was see no thread is unseen.
I found the issue, the threads are already closed from you mark duplicated and send the new reply on the closed thread. so i didn't see them.

You're right, and the badge is 0 now (checked 08:53 UTC).
- Cause: when I merged duplicate threads at 07:55 UTC, some had replies you hadn't opened yet. Closing them moved those replies to the bottom of the list, so the badge counted them but you couldn't find them.
- No agent has written in a closed thread since then (I checked every closed thread).
- The fix is already being built by the thread toolsmith (ts-threads): closed threads stop counting, and a closed thread shows 'Merged into T-xxx' with the related threads listed on the kept one.
- Until it is live, I won't close a thread that has replies you haven't read.
- The lead will say here when it is live.
What you need to do: nothing.
